017package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.dev;
018
019import static java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.*;
020
021import java.io.*;
022import java.time.*;
023import java.time.format.*;
024import java.util.*;
025import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;
026
027import org.apache.juneau.commons.*;
028import org.apache.juneau.http.*;
029import org.apache.juneau.http.response.*;
030import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;

036/**
037 * Dashboard: the dashboard-chrome demo page, built with {@link DevPageBuilders#dashboard(String, int)} only.
038 *
039 * <p>
040 * {@code ?variant=} picks how the {@code orders} source behaves ({@code ok}, {@code slow}, {@code truncated} or
041 * {@code error}; {@code right} behaves as {@code ok} and puts the rail on the right) and {@code ?v=} sets the persist version.  {@code /series/<variant>} serves one CSV row per UTC day in
042 * {@code [start, end)}, filtered by {@code reasons}, {@code q} and {@code lateOnly}; {@code /requests} counts the series
043 * requests, so a test can see Refresh and Clear cache reach the server.
044 *
045 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
046 * <p class='bcode'>
047 *    GET /console/dev/dashboard?variant=slow
048 *    GET /console/dev/dashboard/series/ok?start=2026-10-01T00:00:00Z&amp;end=2026-10-08T00:00:00Z&amp;reasons=late
049 * </p>
050 */
051@Rest(path="/dashboard", title="Dashboard")
052@SuppressWarnings({
053   "java:S110", // Inheritance depth comes from the BasicRestServlet hierarchy, not this page.
054   "resource" // The response writer is owned by the servlet container; Eclipse JDT @Owning warning is by design.
055})
056public class DashboardRest extends PetstoreConsolePage {
057
058   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
059
060   /** Series requests served since startup, for the Refresh and Clear cache checks. */
061   static final AtomicInteger SERIES_REQUESTS = new AtomicInteger();
062
063   private static final List<String> VARIANTS = List.of("ok", "slow", "truncated", "error", "right");
064   private static final List<String> REASONS = List.of("late", "lost", "damaged", "wrong-item");
065   private static final String[] WEEKDAYS = {"Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"};
066   private static final LocalDate FIXED_START = LocalDate.of(2026, 9, 1);
067   private static final int FIXED_DAYS = 28;
068   private static final int TRUNCATE_AT = 20;
069   private static final long SLOW_MS = 2000;
070   private static final Duration MAX_WINDOW = Duration.ofDays(400);
071
072   /**
073    * Renders the Dashboard page.
074    *
075    * @param req The request.
076    * @param variant The source variant; anything unknown is {@code ok}.
077    * @param v The persist version; below 1 (or absent) is 1.
078    * @return The page.
079    */
080   @RestGet(path="/")
081   public View page(RestRequest req, @Query("variant") String variant, @Query("v") Integer v) {
082      return twin(req, DevPageBuilders.dashboard(variant != null && VARIANTS.contains(variant) ? variant : "ok", v == null || v < 1 ? 1 : v));
083   }
084
085   /**
086    * The {@code orders} source: {@code day,reason,orders}, one row per UTC day.
087    *
088    * @param req The request (for the repeated {@code reasons} parameter).
089    * @param res The response.
090    * @param variant {@code ok}, {@code slow} (half the rows, a pause, the rest), {@code truncated} (at most 20 rows and
091    *    the {@code #truncated,20} sentinel) or {@code error} (a 500).
092    * @param q Keeps rows whose reason contains this text, case-insensitively; empty keeps every row.
093    * @param start The window start, ISO-8601; defaults to 30 days before {@code end}.
094    * @param end The window end, ISO-8601, exclusive; defaults to the start of tomorrow (UTC).
095    * @param lateOnly {@code true} keeps only {@code late}.
096    * @throws IOException If the response can't be written.
097    */
098   @RestGet(path="/series/{variant}")
099   @SuppressWarnings({
100      "java:S3776" // Branching is inherent to the demo source's variants.
101   })
102   public void series(RestRequest req, RestResponse res, @Path("variant") String variant, @Query("q") @Schema(aev=true) String q,
103         @Query("start") String start, @Query("end") String end, @Query("lateOnly") String lateOnly) throws IOException {
104      SERIES_REQUESTS.incrementAndGet();
105      if ("error".equals(variant))
106         throw new InternalServerError("The demo source failed on purpose (variant=error).");
107      var reasons = new HashSet<String>();
108      req.getQueryParams().getAll("reasons").forEach(p -> reasons.add(p.getValue()));
109      var e = instant(end, LocalDate.now(ZoneOffset.UTC).plusDays(1).atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant());
110      var s = instant(start, e.minus(Duration.ofDays(30)));
111      if (s.isBefore(e.minus(MAX_WINDOW)))
112         s = e.minus(MAX_WINDOW);
113      var rows = rows(s, e, reasons, q == null || q.isEmpty() ? null : q.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), "true".equals(lateOnly));
114      var truncated = "truncated".equals(variant) && rows.size() > TRUNCATE_AT;
115      if (truncated)
116         rows = rows.subList(0, TRUNCATE_AT);
117      res.setContentType("text/csv;charset=utf-8");
118      res.setHeader("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
119      var w = res.getWriter();
120      w.write("day,reason,orders\n");
121      var half = "slow".equals(variant) ? rows.size() / 2 : rows.size();
122      for (var i = 0; i < rows.size(); i++) {
123         if (i == half && i > 0) {
124            w.flush();
125            res.flushBuffer();
126            try {
127               Thread.sleep(SLOW_MS);
128            } catch (InterruptedException x) {
129               Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
130               return;
131            }
132         }
133         w.write(rows.get(i));
134      }
135      if (truncated)
136         w.write("#truncated," + TRUNCATE_AT + "\n");
137   }
138
139   /**
140    * Orders by reason over a fixed 28 days, for the {@code by-reason} bar and the {@code share} donut.
141    *
142    * @return One row per reason.
143    */
144   @RestGet(path="/reasons")
145   public List<JsonMap> reasons() {
146      var totals = new LinkedHashMap<String,Integer>();
147      REASONS.forEach(r -> totals.put(r, 0));
148      for (var i = 0; i < FIXED_DAYS; i++) {
149         var n = FIXED_START.plusDays(i).toEpochDay();
150         totals.merge(reason(n), orders(n), Integer::sum);
151      }
152      var l = new ArrayList<JsonMap>();
153      totals.forEach((r, o) -> l.add(JsonMap.of("reason", r, "orders", o)));
154      return l;
155   }
156
157   /**
158    * Orders by weekday over the same fixed 28 days, for the {@code by-weekday} bar.
159    *
160    * @return One row per weekday, Monday first.
161    */
162   @RestGet(path="/weekdays")
163   public List<JsonMap> weekdays() {
164      var totals = new int[7];
165      for (var i = 0; i < FIXED_DAYS; i++) {
166         var day = FIXED_START.plusDays(i);
167         totals[day.getDayOfWeek().getValue() - 1] += orders(day.toEpochDay());
168      }
169      var l = new ArrayList<JsonMap>();
170      for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++)
171         l.add(JsonMap.of("weekday", WEEKDAYS[i], "orders", totals[i]));
172      return l;
173   }
174
175   /**
176    * The series request counter.
177    *
178    * @return {@code {series: n}}.
179    */
180   @RestGet(path="/requests")
181   public JsonMap requests() {
182      return JsonMap.of("series", SERIES_REQUESTS.get());
183   }
184
185   /**
186    * Serves the page-local script (the {@code petstore.late} rail section).
187    *
188    * @param res The response.
189    * @throws IOException If the bundled script can't be read.
190    */
191   @RestGet(path="/dashboard.js")
192   public void script(RestResponse res) throws IOException {
193      try (var in = DashboardRest.class.getResourceAsStream("dashboard.js")) {
194         if (in == null)
195            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing classpath resource 'dashboard.js' beside " + DashboardRest.class.getName());
196         res.setContentType("text/javascript;charset=utf-8");
197         res.getWriter().write(new String(in.readAllBytes(), UTF_8));
198      }
199   }
200
201   private static List<String> rows(Instant start, Instant end, Set<String> reasons, String q, boolean lateOnly) {
202      var out = new ArrayList<String>();
203      for (var day = start.atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate(); day.atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant().isBefore(end); day = day.plusDays(1)) {
204         var n = day.toEpochDay();
205         var r = reason(n);
206         if ((reasons.isEmpty() || reasons.contains(r)) && (q == null || r.contains(q)) && (! lateOnly || "late".equals(r)))
207            out.add(day.atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant() + "," + r + "," + orders(n) + "\n");
208      }
209      return out;
210   }
211
212   private static String reason(long epochDay) {
213      return REASONS.get((int) Math.floorMod(epochDay, 4L));
214   }
215
216   private static int orders(long epochDay) {
217      return 10 + (int) Math.floorMod(epochDay * 7, 23L);
218   }
219
220   private static Instant instant(String v, Instant def) {
221      if (v == null || v.isBlank())
222         return def;
223      try {
224         return Instant.parse(v);
225      } catch (DateTimeParseException x) {
226         return def;
227      }
228   }
229}
